description: In-memory dict-based TaskStore. No persistence across restarts. Used for tests and embedded runs only. Mirrors engine/runtime/store.py::MemoryTaskStore.
instructions: Store all TaskRecords in a dict keyed by task_id.
get() must return model_copy(deep=True) — callers must not mutate stored state.
list() returns a shallow copy of matching records filtered by optional status.
No serialization. No cross-process sharing. Ephemeral.
